text:
liz_cs: customer reports invoice spike after using streaming API. says dashboard shows ~1.9k tokens but invoice charged ~3.8k. invoice INV-9876. they cancelled mid-gen twice. attaching request ids.

devon_eng: ok can you paste the SSE frames / request ids?

liz_cs: request_ids: 0a1b2c, 0a1b2c-retry, connect at 2026-03-14T22:11:05Z, client cancel at 22:11:15Z, reconnect 22:11:17Z. here are the raw client logs: 
```
> SSE frame: data: {"seq":1,"tokens":120,"final":false}
> SSE frame: data: {"seq":2,"tokens":80,"final":false}
> SSE frame: data: {"seq":3,"tokens":200,"final":true}
> client -> cancel (xhr abort)
> client reconnect -> starts new stream (same request_id)
> SSE frame: data: {"seq":4,"tokens":50,"final":true}
```

liz_cs: customer says dashboard only shows seq 1-3 (total ~400) but invoice counted seq 1-4 (~450) and then also counted a second finalization on the reconnect (double billing) so invoice doubled.

devon_eng: hmm looks like final frame replayed after reconnect and our metering marked both final frames as separate completions. streaming metering currently counts per-frame tokens and marks a stream closed on any `final:true` frame without de-duplicating across reconnects.

ajay_billing: @devon_eng can we confirm ledger rows? billing-bot, run ledger query for INV-9876 and request 0a1b2c to show token events.

billing-bot: ledger query complete: found token events: ["0a1b2c:seq1:120","0a1b2c:seq2:80","0a1b2c:seq3:200","0a1b2c-retry:seq4:50","finalize:0a1b2c","finalize:0a1b2c-retry"]

ajay_billing: this confirms duplicate finalize lines. will issue provisional credit for INV-9876 while engineering fixes duplication.

devon_eng: repro plan: 1) start SSE stream 2) simulate midstream cancel 3) reconnect using same request id 4) send another `final:true` chunk -> expect double-count. I can reproduce locally with runtime v1.3.2. root cause: runtime treats reconnect as distinct session if no explicit stream-id header, but request_id reuse causes metering to collapse frames into same ledger paths and finalize on each final.

devon_eng: quick mitigation: patch runtime to attach an ephemeral session id to stream and only finalize when session is marked closed by session-id, or dedupe finalizes by final_sequence number + request_id. I have a small patch: 
```diff
- meter.finalize(request_id)
+ if (!meter.finalized_for_session(session_id)) meter.finalize(request_id, session_id)
```

sam_ops: will roll a hotfix to edge fleet (canary 10% -> 100%) within 2h. scheduling now.

liz_cs: told customer provisional credit + ETA for patch 2h. customer asked for root-cause writeup.

devon_eng: adding note: also saw a rare race where client abort triggers server to flush buffered final chunk, then recon sends final with overlapping tokens. fix will de-duplicate by token-range too to be safe.

ajay_billing: credit issued for INV-9876 (ref CR-4501). will reconcile ledger after patch and remove provisional if incorrect.

liz_cs: thanks everyone. posting steps for follow-up to transcript: customer wants opt-in to not reuse request_id for retries; recommend adding client guidance in docs about new session header.

devon_eng: will update docs + add telemetry event `stream_reconnect_with_request_id` to detect recurrence. :eyes:

sam_ops: rolled canary -> no errors in 10% after 30m, promoting to 50%. monitoring metering events.

liz_cs: customer confirmed provisional credit accepted and will await final invoice correction. closing loop once ledger reconciled. :thumbsup:
